title: papaver alpinum subvar. sulphurellum
intro: Papaver alpinum subvar. sulphurellum, commonly known as Himalayan poppy, is a plant species that belongs to the poppy family (Papaveraceae). The plant is known for its medicinal properties, including its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and promote relaxation, making it a valuable asset in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Papaver alpinum subvar. sulphurellum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. However, there is limited information available on the specific bioactive constituents of this plant, and further research is needed to fully understand its medicinal potential.
